panels.title: E10 · Are users actually getting a good service?
panels.description: Missing input, release R2: no number is shown. Contract: config/panel-contracts/ttv-service.yaml (panel 1).

options.content:
**Release R2 · missing input.** This card shows no number until the inputs below exist.

**What it will show.** Per logical deployment: real traffic, successful complete requests, latency SLO attainment (time to first token, inter-token and end-to-end), error budget where defined, saturation, and rejected or timed-out demand. One counter of record per deployment; per-instance percentiles are never averaged.

**Missing inputs**

| Input | Where it would come from |
| --- | --- |
| Service graph: deployment → access path → serving pods | Kube API of each target cluster (KServe, llm-d, vLLM, Routes, Gateways), read-only |
| Versioned serving-engine metric mapping | Discovered from live metrics through Thanos, never hard-coded |
| SLOs per service (latency and success) | Configuration, approved by the service owner |
| Useful-use policy (open input I2) | Proposed from Discovery traffic data; until approved, LOW_USE stays *unverified* |
| Traffic class: real, probe, warm-up, benchmark | Labels where instrumentation has them; otherwise *user attribution unverified* |

**Onboarding step.** R2 discovers services per target cluster, records the metric mapping and loads SLOs; aggregated per-service series then feed this page.

**Answer today (R1).** [GPU use](/d/ttv-gpu-use) separates serving GPUs with genuine requests from loaded models with no real demand.

panels.title: E11 · Is adoption growing beyond a few consumers?
panels.description: Missing input, release R2: no number is shown. Contract: config/panel-contracts/ttv-service.yaml (panel 2).

options.content:
**Release R2 · missing input.** This card shows no number until the inputs below exist.

**What it will show.** Active consuming teams and services, new versus returning aggregate cohorts, traffic concentration on the top consumers, approved use cases, published services with little genuine demand, and publication-to-adoption delay. Aggregates only: requests are not people, and prompt content is never read.

**Missing inputs**

| Input | Where it would come from |
| --- | --- |
| Consumer identity at team level (gateway client or API key → team) | API gateway or auth aggregates, only where permitted |
| Approval to use that identity | Privacy and owner approval, recorded in configuration |
| Publication evidence (published vs NOT_PUBLISHED) | Service graph (R2) |
| Approved use-case register | Versioned import |
| Useful-use policy (open input I2) | As for E10 |

**Onboarding step.** Confirm which consumer identity may be used, map it to teams in configuration and add publication evidence; cohorts then build from aggregated traffic.

**Answer today (R1).** [Queues](/d/ttv-queues): the reason breakdown shows Serving GPUs with NO_REAL_DEMAND and LOW_USE.
